items.title: Defending champion Lumbini Lions cruise into the final
items.summary: The Lions defeated Sudurpaschim Royals by 6 wickets in Qualifier 1 on Tuesday. Sudurpaschim, meanwhile, still have a chance to reach the final by winning Qualifier 2.

items.title: Why has Election Commission yet to update Nepali Congress leadership records?
items.summary: The commission says it is still examining documents and constitutional amendments submitted by the party, but the delay has raised questions within the Congress amid a lingering dispute over its leadership.

items.title: Flood victims occupy Nepal Electricity Authority land, erect tents
items.summary: More than 250 displaced families from Trishuli Bazar cleared the land using an excavator, accusing the government of delaying their rehabilitation.

items.title: At Nepal tax awards, finance minister raises low investment paradox
items.summary: As the government honours top taxpayers for their fiscal contributions, businesses caution that structural bottlenecks, policy instability, and market risks continue to dampen long-term investment appetite.

items.title: Millions flowed into former teacher Inam Sapkota’s account in a year
items.summary: Bank records show Rs63.1 million deposited into the fixer’s account, with large sums transferred to company accounts soon afterwards.

items.title: Shah must use his India visit to push for progress on longstanding issues
items.summary: The prime minister must firmly advance Nepal’s interests while deepening bilateral cooperation.

items.title: What Mithila’s stray bulls tell us about Nepal’s economy
items.summary: An economy built on exporting its youth and taxing its imports is not developing; it is liquidating its future.

items.title: How crony capitalism keeps Nepalis poor
items.summary: Since 1990, favouring connections over competence may have kept Nepali incomes a third below their potential.

items.title: Nepali youth press COP31 presidency for grants to rebuild after disasters
items.summary: Activists tell Australian negotiators in Antalya that countries that did little to cause the climate crisis should not have to borrow to recover from it.

items.title: Last-minute push to secure mountain agenda in COP31 outcome
items.summary: The latest draft proposes a dedicated programme on mountain regions, but Nepal wants clear commitments on climate adaptation, research and finance.

items.title: Explained: Nepal and India have revived stalled air route talks. Here’s what you need to know
items.summary: Kathmandu is pushing for two-way access to the Mahendranagar route, stalled by security concerns and strategic mistrust for years.

items.title: Dipendra’s half-century fails to lift Sudurpaschim as Lumbini restrict them to 105
items.summary: Sudurpaschim managed just 20 runs in the opening powerplay before their captain scored a fighting 52, but the Royals were bowled out of momentum and finished on 105 for eight in Qualifier 1.

items.title: ‘Death is near’: Inside the hoax bomb threats that rattled Europe’s schools and airports
items.summary: Most targets were schools in the ​United Kingdom, Ireland and Italy. But media organisations, airlines, airports, charities and private individuals were also caught up in the campaign.

items.title: Lumbini Lions and Sudurpaschim Royals eye final spot
items.summary: The winners of Qualifier 1 will advance directly to the Nepal Premier League final, while the losing side will get another chance through Qualifier 2.

items.title: Dhiraaj Rajbanshi on filming ‘Himalayan Gold’, a yarsagumba thriller, above 3,800 metres
items.summary: The director's debut film, out on Friday, explores a little-seen world of Nepal’s mountain communities. He says the story began with tales of robberies in Rukum highlands.

items.title: How individual labour permits for Europe grew 22-fold in five years
items.summary: A new study says the suspension of demand-letter verification has pushed job seekers to informal agents, exposing them to fraud, debt and exploitation.

items.title: Police seize Rs16.7 million in unaccounted cash in Lalitpur
items.summary: A team from the Kathmandu Valley Crime Investigation Office recovered the money after receiving information about a suspicious financial transaction.

items.title: Nepal gets India’s approval to import 350MW and export 56MW
items.summary: The approval allows the NEA to purchase electricity for up to 17 hours a day to meet winter demand while continuing exports from three hydropower projects.

items.title: Dusit Thani Dhulikhel hosts first-ever Cake Mixing ceremony
items.summary: The resort plans to make the celebration an annual festive tradition, bringing together guests, tourism representatives and corporate partners.

items.title: From selling soap door-to-door to building a 22-million-subscriber podcast
items.summary: Raj Shamani’s journey from helping revive his family’s struggling business to interviewing world leaders reflects the growing influence of India’s digital creators and the power of consistency in building an audience.

items.title: Supreme Court to hear Karki’s petition against removal on Wednesday
items.summary: The former police chief has challenged the Cabinet’s decision to remove him and appoint Manoj Kumar KC as inspector general, arguing that the move was unlawful.

items.title: With Robert Pattinson, James Bond remains a white, British man
items.summary: Despite how Bond has come to be characterised onscreen, Fleming’s initial open-endedness means there is still space to reimagine what Bond looks like, and even who he is.
